protocol.layout: Raw C-order token-major flat rows, recurrent input [N,128,9], DPLSTM hidden32, last hidden state, six logits.
protocol.preprocessing: Contract applies clip(x,-b,b)/b once; fixed public design constants, not empirical extrema.
protocol.central: Reuse frozen R3 model identities and once-scored metrics after exact split/bounds/init verification: Adam .01, batch256, 20 epochs, reset each four epochs, 580 steps.
protocol.nonprivate_federated: Selected five-round schedule, equal site weights, paired public Poisson streams, expected-batch divisor, no clipping or noise, reset optimizer each round.
protocol.clipped_noiseless: Same as nonprivate twin, installed _dp_fit with sigma0: coordinate clamp +/-1 then per-window global norm1 clipping.
protocol.pooled_dp: Not scheduled; prioritize the three-site DP matrix and both noiseless controls.
protocol.trivial: TRAIN class frequencies; TRAIN majority class.
protocol.scoring: Exclusive scoring marker after all training and verification; official TEST read once; each new model predicted once. No alternative or retraining after scoring.
protocol.gap: Federated-DP macro-AUC minus paired central; mean and sample SD over three seeds.
protocol.privacy_scope: Window-level mechanism measurement on subject-disjoint sites; no subject-level protection. No end-to-end private selection or campaign-wide composition guarantee.
protocol.randomness: Public initialization seeds; unchanged node-owned cryptographic sampling/noise.

runtime.privacy_randomness: Unchanged node-owned cryptographic sampling and Gaussian-noise streams.

interpretation: Window-level mechanism measurement on subject-disjoint sites; no subject-level protection. Schedule selected on TRAIN subjects by real epsilon-8 inner-validation mean macro-AUC. The central gap includes finite-schedule, federation, clipping and noise effects; the matched clipped-noiseless contrast estimates marginal noise cost with independent sampling streams.
